column2: Retain Joash's age of seven at accession as the first unit of this chapter. The selected numbering is not moved back to chapter 11 to match a different verse system.

Retain accession in Jehu's seventh year, forty years in Jerusalem and Abia of Beersheba as his mother. Abia is not silently replaced by another familiar maternal form; the geographical origin remains.

Retain upright conduct during the days Jehoiada enlightened him. Enlightened follows photizo provisionally; the temporal qualification is not expanded into a complete account of later apostasy absent from this verse.
Retain the high places not removed and the people's continued sacrifice and incense there. The plural passive avoids assigning an unexpressed individual agent for the failure.

Retain all holy silver received, the repeated assessment-silver construction and voluntary heart-prompted contributions. The difficult each-man-taking phrase is preserved rather than being replaced with a census tax or a familiar parallel funding system.
column3: How do the two assessment phrases relate, and what transaction is described by each man taking assessment silver?

column2: Retain priestly receipt for themselves, each from their sale, and strengthening bedek wherever it occurs. Bedek is an unresolved repair-related term in context; sale follows prasis rather than an imported acquaintance relationship.
column3: Should bedek be rendered damage, breach or disrepair, and how does strengthening it express repairing the building? What is the referent of their sale?

column2: Retain Joash's twenty-third year and the priests' failure to strengthen the house's bedek. The elapsed time is not shortened or explained by an unmentioned diversion of money.

Retain the king's summons to Jehoiada and the priests, question about the failure and prohibition on taking silver from sales, with its redirection to repairs. But expresses the contrast to the causal/directive hoti clause naturally; the precise collection arrangement remains open.

Retain both agreed negatives: not taking silver from the people and not themselves strengthening bedek. The second negative is not removed as a supposed error; it marks the change of responsibility in the following account.

Retain the chest, bored board, Iamibin and the difficult house-of-a-man-of-the-Lord's-house location. Priests guarding the doorpost put in all silver found. Neither an altar location nor an uncomplicated right-side entry position is substituted for the selected wording.
column3: What does iamibin mean, and how do the successive house/man genitives locate the chest? Board may be a lid, but that architecture is not independently settled.

column2: Retain the large quantity prompting royal scribe and high priest to come up, bind and count the silver. Binding is explicit; bags, seals or a modern audit procedure are not supplied as facts.

Retain prepared silver passed to the work overseers and paid to carpenters and builders. The appositional reading of workers/overseers is provisional; the sentence continues to the other laborers and purchases in verse 13.
column3: Are those doing the work identical with the overseers or a separate group receiving money through them?

column2: Retain wall builders, stone quarriers, timber and quarried stone purchases and expenditure to strengthen the house's bedek. The technical repair term is handled consistently; no artistic decoration is added to the stated construction materials.

Retain the prohibition on using this silver for silver doors, nails, bowls, trumpets or gold/silver vessels. Doors and nails follow the selected list rather than familiar alternate implements; were not to be made preserves the future's directive force.

Propose For they would give it to retain hoti linking the workers' funding to the preceding excluded objects. The distribution and completed strengthening with the silver remain, including the selected shift from future giving to past repair.
Retain not calling the intermediaries to account because of their trustworthiness. The text commends the particular agents; it is not expanded into a general rule against financial accountability.
Retain sin and trespass silver brought into the Lord's house and belonging to priests. The selected positive brought-in clause is not changed into a prohibition on bringing those funds to the house.
Retain Hazael's attack and capture of Gath and setting his face toward Jerusalem. The directional idiom expresses intention without adding a completed siege in this verse.

Retain the three ancestral kings' consecrated things, Joash's own and all gold in both treasuries, sent to Hazael. The final he going away is contextually Hazael; the narrative does not enumerate additional casualties or a formal treaty.
Retain Joash's remaining acts, all he did, Behold and the Judah annals question. The source reference remains descriptive and is not claimed to identify a surviving document.

Retain the slaves' uprising, bound-together conspiracy and attack in Mallo's house in Gaalla. Bound together interprets the idiom; the force of panta with conspiracy is unresolved and the two names are not silently replaced with Millo/Silla.
column3: Does panta syndesmon mean a full conspiracy or every conspiratorial bond, and how should the selected locations be treated?

column2: Retain Jezichar/Jemuath and the difficult Jezebuth–his son Shomer sequence, the servants' attack, death, burial and Amaziah's succession. The inherited dashes mark uncertainty rather than a settled genealogy; a familiar two-assassin patronymic list is not substituted.
column3: How many people are named in the second sequence, and how does his son Shomer attach to Jezebuth and the preceding names?

column2: Retain Jehoahaz son of Jehu's accession in Judah's Joash son of Ahaziah's twenty-third year, and seventeen years in Samaria. The repeated Greek year formula is naturally compressed without changing the figures.
Retain evil in the Lord's eyes, following Jeroboam son of Nebat's sins and not turning from them. The causal role of Jeroboam in Israel's sin remains explicit.

Retain the Lord's fierce anger and delivery into both Hazael's hand and his son the son-of-Ader's hand, all the days. Both royal generations remain; no single reign is substituted for the extended oppression.

Retain Jehoahaz entreating the Lord's face, the Lord's listening and sight of Israel's affliction under Syria's king. The two causal clauses remain, and the face idiom is not treated as a physical description of God.

Retain deliverance given to Israel, emergence from beneath Syria's hand and dwelling as formerly. Deliverance follows soteria, not a separately named deliverer; former days naturally renders yesterday and the third day without literal calendrical calculation.

Retain failure to leave Jeroboam-house sins, walking in them and the grove standing in Samaria. The collective they remains, and grove is not confidently replaced by a particular cult statue absent a lexical decision.

Retain the explanatory For, fifty horsemen, ten chariots and ten thousand foot soldiers, destruction by Syria's king and dust-for-trampling image. The final they made is plural in Greek; it is not automatically corrected to singular king.
Retain Jehoahaz's remaining deeds, everything done, mighty acts and the Israel chronicles question. This formula lacks a presentative in the selected wording, so none is inserted.
Retain death with fathers, burial with fathers in Samaria and Joash's succession. Both father references remain, and Joash is identified as son of the just-mentioned Jehoahaz.

Retain the two same-named Joash kings, Judah's thirty-seventh year and Israel's sixteen-year reign in Samaria. Paternal and kingdom distinctions prevent merging the rulers; chronology is not harmonized with neighboring totals.

Propose any sin for every sin under did not turn away. This makes the negative scope natural in English and avoids suggesting that he abandoned some sins but not all; the following walked in them supports continued adherence. The close draft keeps the inherited every wording for review.
column3: The negative scope of pasa is interpreted contextually as no departure from any of these sins; independent syntactic review remains pending.

column2: Retain Joash's deeds, all he did and mighty acts with Amaziah king of Judah. With preserves meta without converting the relation into either alliance or opposition before the later account supplies its context.

Retain Joash's death and Jeroboam seated on his throne in Samaria with Israel's sons. This selected ending does not narrate Joash's burial, and with the sons of Israel is not rewritten as with the kings of Israel.
column3: How does the final with-Israel's-sons phrase relate to Jeroboam's enthronement, and is the locative Samaria attached to the throne clause as rendered?

column2: Retain Elisha's final illness, Joash's visit and weeping over his face, doubled Father and singular horseman. The words echo the Elijah scene without changing horseman to a plural force or adding a diagnosis.

Retain the request for bow and arrows and their bringing to Elisha. The distinction between singular bow and plural arrows is explicit here and provides context for the different plural word in verse 18.
Retain the king's hand on the bow and Elisha's hands upon the king's hands. Singular and plural shifts are selected; the gestures are not reduced to a generic blessing.

Retain eastward window opening, shooting, deliverance for the Lord and against Syria, and Aphek to completion. Against interprets en Syria in the announced conflict rather than a purely locative in Syria; the dative for the Lord remains distinct.
column3: Should the two deliverance prepositions be rendered for/from the Lord and in/against Syria, and what relation does the military context justify?

column2: Retain bows provisionally for plural toxa, the ground-striking command and three strikes before stopping. This does not settle whether the plural denotes bows, arrows or archery equipment in context; the lexical question is explicit rather than silently harmonized with verse 15.
column3: Does plural toxa here mean arrows by extension, and would arrows be a more accurate contextual rendering than inherited bows?

column2: Retain the man of God's grief, conditional five or six strikes, complete Syrian defeat as the unrealized outcome and three future victories. Grieved follows lypeo rather than automatically substituting anger, and both alternative counts remain.

Retain Elisha's death and burial and Moabite lightly equipped raiders arriving when the year came round. The seasonal phrase is not turned into an exact calendar date; the plural raiders differs from the next unit's singular sighting.

Propose behold for suddenly to preserve the selected presentative without adding a distinct assertion of abrupt timing. Retain singular lightly equipped raider, the corpse thrown into Elisha's grave, movement and contact with bones, life and standing. The unusual movement before revival is not silently reordered.
column3: What subject or physical motion is intended by he went before touching the bones, and does the singular raider function collectively?

column2: Retain Hazael's oppression throughout Jehoahaz's days. This recap is not repositioned or removed as a duplicate of the earlier royal notice.

Retain mercy, pity and regard because of the covenant with Abraham, Isaac and Jacob, followed by unwillingness to destroy or cast away. The selected verse has no until now at its end; none is imported.
Retain Hazael's death and the succession of his son called son of Ader. The two son expressions carry distinct functions, genealogy and royal designation, and are both preserved.

Retain Joash son of Jehoahaz's recovery of towns from Hazael's son, prior capture from his father, three victories and restored Israelite towns. Took back naturally compresses returned-and-took; the three fulfills the earlier limited-victory announcement without inventing additional conquests.
